description: Deploy an event-driven workflow that routes S3 uploads to either Lambda or Fargate via Step Functions based on file size. Uses EventBridge to trigger a Step Functions state machine when objects are uploaded to S3. Small files are processed by Lambda, large files by a Fargate task. Includes VPC, ECR repository, ECS cluster, and scoped IAM roles. Trigger keywords: Step Functions, Fargate, Lambda, S3 event, EventBridge, ECS, ECR, file processing, workflow orchestration, serverless.
